The '''Cavern of Light''' was an underground cavern located on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] identified as [[ZXK-100346.6a]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
During the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], a group of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] defeated a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], who wielded a dangerous artifact known as the [[Soulsaber]]. They constructed the Cavern of Light to hide it in, using the power of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] to prevent it from being taken.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Dark Jedi [[Thaum Rystra]] traveled to the cavern in order to steal the Soulsaber. He brought with him [[Caeleb]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] child whom he used to help retrieve the Soulsaber, as Rystra could not get it on his own, due to its protection by the light side. However, a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents attacked Rystra in the cavern. He could not defeat them, so he abandoned Caeleb and fled with the Soulsaber.
